svg.title: Craft backend meta-types: a connected definition graph
svg.desc: Exactly one definition box per backend meta-type. Directed labeled arrows connect those same boxes, with seventeen canonical signatures and a dashed field-type reference to Enum. Entity self-loops describe relationships between Entity instances, not a claim that an instance owns itself.
svg.text: 13 meta-types · 17 directed relationship signatures · one connected map

g.text: Typed record of a fact that already
Projects source fields into a target

svg.text: Solid arrows: canonical signatures. Dashed arrow: field typing. Crossed wires do not imply a connection.
Entity loops mean Entity → Entity between instances. Saga is represented by Workflow.

g.text: Identity, values, behavior, boundaries and lifecycle.
Rules gate; Calculations derive; Workflows coordinate.
Interfaces expose; Policies choose; Mappings project.
Reads, creation, embedded values and event subjects.
Events activate behavior; Operations project to other features.
Lifecycle responsibility and assignment carry different meaning.
